mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital flows into equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals labor market tightening that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE drops below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP (GDPC1) above 1% and 0.5% respectively over 3 months indicate accelerating consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 1% and GDPC1 rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and GDPC1 exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) combined with near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates a favorable environment for equity valuation expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 signals sustained manufacturing momentum that correlates with rising corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 100,000 persons (100 in series units) in a single month indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and equity demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises above 100.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% over 3 months signal strengthening consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed 0.5% thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates central bank policy accommodation that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
